dependencies.basis: DGBAS Manpower Survey (labour force / employment and unemployment statistics) employs the International Labour Organization’s standard definitions of employment and unemployment and recommended statistical methods.
dependencies.evidence_quote: This survey, like similar surveys in many other countries, employs the International Labor Organization's standard definitions of employment and unemployment and recommended statistical methods.

dependencies.basis: Labour productivity indicators are constructed using employment and related labour-input data from the Manpower Survey.
dependencies.evidence_quote: In order to understand the short-term situation in national labor force utilization, status changes, and employment and unemployment, it has been conducting the Manpower utilization survey attached with the Manpower Survey

dependencies.basis: CBC Financial Stability Report cites and uses DGBAS national accounts (GDP, economic growth) and CPI figures as key macroeconomic context indicators.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data cited from the DGBAS in this report, including Taiwan’s economic growth rate, GDP, and CPI figures, are based on its press release published on May 28, 2025. ... Sources: CBC and DGBAS.

dependencies.basis: CBC Financial Stability Report incorporates DGBAS CPI inflation data alongside GDP for macroeconomic assessment.
